einzeiler: Behind the scenes of the launch and emotional journey of NASA's Roman Space Telescope.
kurzfassung: Producer Christian Elliott accompanied the team to Kennedy Space Center for the launch of NASA's Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope. Scientists who dedicated decades to the mission shared their emotional experiences leading up to liftoff. Following a successful launch on a SpaceX Falcon Heavy rocket, the telescope begins its journey toward Lagrange Point 2.
stichpunkte: Dominic Benford spent over twenty years working on the Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope.
The telescope was built at Goddard Space Flight Center and transported by barge to Florida.
Teams at Kennedy Space Center loaded 1,000 kilograms of hypergolic fuel and encapsulated the telescope.
Launch preparations faced severe summer storms and a strict thirty-second launch window.
Thousands gathered at the NASA causeway to watch the early morning liftoff.
The spacecraft successfully separated and began transmitting telemetry data toward Lagrange Point 2.
A three-month commissioning phase will calibrate instruments before scientific observations begin.

clips.hook: Dedicated most of a career to one mission
clips.text: A scientist reflects on spending more than twenty years of his professional life working on the space telescope.

clips.hook: Loading a thousand kilograms of dangerous fuel
clips.text: The spacecraft is fueled with a massive amount of hazardous propellant in a process that takes an entire week.

clips.hook: Very untypical and crazy traffic for a launch
clips.text: A veteran traffic volunteer expresses astonishment at the unprecedented crowds gathered for the event.

clips.hook: Witnessing the most unbelievable, picture-perfect launch
clips.text: After years of doubt, watching the observatory successfully ascend into the sky felt completely surreal.

clips.hook: Roman data will be freely accessible immediately
clips.text: All collected data will be made available to the public right away without any proprietary delays.

beschreibung:
NASA’s Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope is in space, taking its first steps to explore the cosmos. Relive Roman’s launch—and the emotion that goes along with the roar of a rocket—with NASA experts who worked on the telescope for years. Plus, learn what happens next and when to expect Roman’s first images.

Learn more about the Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope at nasa.gov/roman.
untertitel: Behind the scenes of the final preparations and big emotions
